title: Prime numbers
examples: Teacher, what is the smallest prime number?
How do I know if a number is prime?
Can you show me how the sieve works?

explain.say: Today we are learning about special numbers called prime numbers. A prime number is a whole number greater than one.
A prime number only has two different factors. These factors are always one and itself. For example, seven is prime.
A composite number has more than two factors. This means it can be divided by numbers other than one and itself. For example, twelve is composite.
We can use a method called the sieve to find primes. We start listing numbers and cross out the multiples of smaller primes. This helps us find them all.

items: Move to 3 and cross out its multiples

explain.say: These numbers are important in making secret codes and keeping online information safe. They help computers do very complex calculations.
A common mistake is thinking that because a number ends in five, it cannot be prime. Remember that five itself is a prime number.

faq.q: What is the smallest prime number?
faq.a: The smallest prime number is two. Remember that one is not considered a prime number.
No, two is the only even prime number. All other even numbers are composite because they are divisible by two.

faq.q: How do I check if a big number is prime?
faq.a: You need to check if it is divisible by any prime numbers up to its square root. This can get quite tricky for large numbers.
asks: What is the best way to test it?

faq.q: What is the difference between prime and composite?
faq.a: A prime number only has two factors, one and itself. A composite number has more than two factors.
asks: Can you give me an example of both?

faq.q: Does the sieve work for all numbers?
faq.a: The sieve is a systematic way to test numbers up to a certain limit. It is very helpful for finding all primes in a small range.

facts: The number two is the only even prime number.
A prime number has exactly two factors: one and itself.
The number one is neither prime nor composite.
The smallest composite number is four.

quiz.say: If we use the sieve up to 10, which number would be crossed out after checking 2?
quiz.why: The sieve crosses out all multiples of the prime number two.

wrong.0: Seven is prime and is not a multiple of two.
wrong.2: Three is a prime number and would not be crossed out by two.
wrong.3: Five is prime and is not a multiple of two.
